checks.selectionRationale: Only directly changed Training/Survey contracts and their shared identity/media/report consumers. No full platform or performance benchmark. Twelve independently reviewed reset/FINAL PostgreSQL cases and the admitted whole-file groups must not repeat. Security dependency repair uses genuine Zod4.6.7; four additional directly affected Bundle, error-message and FORM foundation contracts run in CI. Twenty local frozen-schema/array-bound contracts and one strict-grant case already passed locally; no claim of exhaustive Zod compatibility. Twelve PostgreSQL cases and cross-schema types were freshly revalidated on new dependencies, not inherited from Zod3.
